evidence.section: Determination of CMV and EBV seropositivity
evidence.quote: Determination of CMV and EBV seropositivity was conducted by ELISA using the cytomegalovirus (CMV) IgG ELISA kit (Calbiotech, cat. # CM027G).

evidence.section: Whole blood microarray analysis of gene expression
evidence.quote: For each sample, 750 ng of total RNA were hybridized to Beadchips (HumanHT-12v3 Expression Bead Chip, Illumina) that contains 48,771 probes for around 25,000 annotated genes. The hybridized Beadchips were scanned on an Illumina BeadScan confocal scanner and analyzed by Illumina's GenomeStudio software, version 2.0.

Whole blood, PBMC or serum from the first visit (baseline - day 0) was processed and used for determination of gene expression, leukocyte subset frequency, signaling responses to stimulation, serum cytokine and chemokine levels, and CMV and EBV serostatus.

evidence.section: Phosphorylation of intracellular proteins by phosphoflow analysis
evidence.quote: Cells were then distributed in 96-deep well blocks (2 ml) and stimulated with IFN-γ, IL-2, IL-6, IL-7, IL-10 or IL-21 at 50 ng/ml or with 10 4 U/ml IFN-α for 15 minutes. After several washes with FACS buffer, stimulated and barcoded cells were pooled into single tubes and stained for 30 min at 4ºC with an antibody cocktail containing anti-pSTAT1 Alexa Fluor 488, pSTAT3 Alexa Fluor 647, pSTAT5 PE, CD3 Pacific Blue, CD4 PerCP-Cy5.5, CD20 PerCP-Cy5.5 and CD33 PE-Cy7 (all from BD Phosflow). After washing, cells were resuspended in FACS buffer and acquisition was performed on an LSRII instrument (BD Biosciences). Phosphorylation of STAT1, 3, and 5 proteins in B cells, CD4(+) or CD4(+) CD3(+) T cells or monocytes was analyzed by deconvolution of stimuli-specific gating. Baseline levels and fold increase between stimulated and unstimulated conditions were calculated using the 90 th percentile fluorescence intensity of the pSTAT1, 3, or 5 signals.

evidence.section: Phosphorylation of intracellular proteins by phosphoflow analysis
evidence.quote: Data was collected using DIVA software in an LRSII instrument (BD Biosciences).

Cytokines were measured using a Luminex system (Luminex Corp). Plates were read using a Luminex LabMap200 instrument with a lower bound of 100 beads per sample per measured cytokine. The Luminex LabMap200 outputs the fluorescence intensity of each bead measured for a given cytokine in a sample.

The HAI assay was performed on sera from day 0 and day 28 using a standard technique ( 66 ); serially diluted 25-µl aliquots of serum samples in PBS were mixed with 25-µl aliquots of virus matching the vaccine strain composition for that years, corresponding to 4 HA units, in V-bottom 96-well plates (Nunc) and incubated for 30 min at room temperature. At the end of the incubation, 50 µl of 0.5% chicken red blood cells was added and incubated for a minimum of 45 min before reading for HAI activity. The HAI titer of a given sample was defined as the reciprocal of the last serum dilution with no HA activity.

evidence.section: Quantification of IAV in infected lung tissue
evidence.quote: Lung homogenates were titered by plaque assay on Madin-Darby canine kidney (MDCK) cells. Near confluent 25-cm2 monolayers of MDCK cells were infected with 1 ml of homogenate or dilution of homogenate (in general, six tenfold dilutions of lungs were tested) for 1 h at 37°C. Plaques were visualized with crystal violet.

All samples were genotyped using the custom designed ImmunoChip array (Illumina). Genotyping arrays were processed using 400ng of genomic DNA according to the manufactures protocols. Genotype calls were generated using the Gentrain2 Algorithm implemented in Illumina GenomeStudio software.

Seven days after IAV infection, influenza viral titer was determined (upper panel) and IAV-specific T cells were enumerated from the BAL of IAV+ MCMV− (MCMV−) or IAV+ MCMV+ (MCMV+) mice by tetramer staining for NP, PA and PB1-specific responses.
